client_status_timestamps.name: client_status_timestamps
client_status_timestamps.value: ("identity"."client_profiles"."status" <> 'active' OR "identity"."client_profiles"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("identity"."client_profiles"."status" <> 'archived' OR "identity"."client_profiles"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

coach_profiles_parent.name: coach_profiles_parent
coach_profiles_parent.where: "identity"."coach_profiles"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "identity"."coach_profiles"."parent_coach_id" IS NOT NULL

users_email_or_social.name: users_email_or_social
users_email_or_social.value: "identity"."users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "identity"."users"."email_verified_at" IS NOT NULL

sessions_client_day_unique.name: sessions_client_day_unique
sessions_client_day_unique.where: "training"."workout_sessions"."program_day_id" IS NOT NULL AND "training"."workout_sessions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

session_completion.name: session_completion
session_completion.value: "training"."workout_sessions"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("training"."workout_sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training"."workout_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
